idea.name: Geosports daily sports geography game
idea.one_liner: A daily web game for sports and geography fans: answer location questions, then earn revenue through ads and optional Pro subscriptions.
idea.customer: People who enjoy sports and geography trivia, including players who share results with friends.
idea.offer: A daily five-question game where players tap where sports events happened.
idea.revenue_model: Advertising and optional Pro subscriptions; the transcript does not break out revenue by game.

acquisition_channels.details: Players share scores and send the game to friends in group chats; Frank attributes most traffic to word of mouth.
Frank posts a daily question on X and Instagram Stories; he also made posts about the game on X.
Sports media personalities and athletes host daily questions and retweet announcements to reach new audiences.
Frank says he DMs sports media personalities and athletes who have liked game posts to recruit hosts.

ideas.delivery: Players open the web game and tap locations in response to clues. Frank and hosts provide the daily questions; the app handles scoring, sharing, ads and subscriptions.

uk_legal_risk.reason: Host recruitment includes social DMs to individual sports personalities and athletes. Under the requested UK filter, unsolicited marketing DMs to individuals are banned; the transcript says core player acquisition is mostly word of mouth and sharing, so this risk is mainly in host recruitment.

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR may apply to player and advertising data; PECR may apply to cookies and advertising technologies; DMCC Act subscription rules may apply to Pro subscriptions.
